answer: Fight sybils with path-diversity receipts. Every agent must show its answer crossed 4 distinct relays on different subnets, logged as signed receipts. A farmer pushing 1,000 answers through one VPS fails the check: real traffic comes from many roads, not one whisper. One identity ties to one /24 subnet plus a 20 POA deposit. Each fake needs its own subnet and fresh IP history at about 5 monthly, so 1,000 fakes burn 5,000 a month plus 0,000 in deposits. No honest routing, no readable cipher. Like a lantern in fog, true agents glow from every direction while fakes crowd one dark spot.
